title: 'Reckless': Prince Harry, Meghan's children targeted by 'European paparazzi' at UK school
summary_full: Concerns have arisen regarding Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's children's safety as European paparazzi have been spotted lurking near their new school, jeopardizing their privacy. This move back to Britain was intended to protect their family. Harry's longstanding battle against media invasions began after the death of Princess Diana. The couple has previously changed schools due to similar security issues, and the brothers’ relationship continues to face challenges.
